tickets.title: Security
tickets.description: Protect student schedules and academic information from unauthorized access. Ensure that students can only view their own academic data.

tickets.title: Auditability
tickets.description: Record all prerequisite override actions with advisor identity, timestamp, and justification to support auditing and compliance requirements.

tickets.title: Usability
tickets.description: Provide an intuitive drag-and-drop academic planning experience that allows students to create and manage roadmaps with minimal training.
